label: FP
reason: User input from headers flows through doSomething() but the returned bar variable is never used in the response output. The response writes user (derived from class name), cookie name (derived from class name), and cookie value (from SecureRandom-generated random number), none of which contain the user-controlled param. The taint analysis incorrectly flags the printWriter usage as vulnerable.

evidence.note: Response prints user, cookie name, and cookie value - none reference the tainted bar variable from doSomething
